newsitem.title: USA: ERICSSON, OMNIPOINT IN PACT FOR BOSTON, MIAMI.
newsitem.headline: ERICSSON, OMNIPOINT IN PACT FOR BOSTON, MIAMI.

text.p: Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson on Thursday said it has signed an agreement to supply Omnipoint Corp with equipment and services in the Boston and Miami markets.

The five-year agreement contains $100 million in financing for the build-out in 1998 of the two markets. Ericsson said that figure is expected to be increased to $250 million in the coming months. The agreement also provides for an additional $100 million.

Ericsson will supply Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) equipment, including mobile switching centers, base station controllers and radio base station equipment, as well as implementation and support services to Omnipoint.
The agreement builds upon previous contracts between the two companies for similar services in eastern states like New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
